title: Audit the final P104 helper and its uniquely required pulse weights
body:
**Scoped independent audit:** the final helper split in [PR #7781](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7781) preserves all 1,279 prescribed public outputs. Its three fixed pulse weights are uniquely required over the rationals. A partial omission can corrupt old owners even though omitting all three fresh-input terms loses only the fresh return. **No new kappa** or complete supplier admission is claimed.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9314a3e1a17fdb4f89a1578a6d3886a51384f217/research/p104-final-helper-audit/PROOF.md), [exact certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9314a3e1a17fdb4f89a1578a6d3886a51384f217/research/p104-final-helper-audit/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9314a3e1a17fdb4f89a1578a6d3886a51384f217/research/p104-final-helper-audit/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9314a3e1a17fdb4f89a1578a6d3886a51384f217/research/p104-final-helper-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9314a3e1a17fdb4f89a1578a6d3886a51384f217/research/p104-final-helper-audit/CREDITS.md). The audited source is `913fb6febe28cc3ccad1c16de8e45b8bce0da063`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Exact final split | 48 changed rows; both published graph hashes recovered |
| Arbitrary-input maps | Old forward, new forward and new adjoint; 4,904,966 coefficient positions |
| Fixed pulse family | Rank-three response; a three-row minor has determinant 25/4 |
| Negative controls | All eight fresh-term omission subsets and twelve rational pulse controls |
| Native rank change | 5,714 paid MOVEs unchanged; one rank-eight target becomes two rank-four targets |

For sends 92740, 98411 and 98796, let R_i be the output response to the stated pulse divided by eight. The checker shows that each pulse is invisible to both local probes. Their response columns are independent. If their complete pulse weights are lambda_i, the full error is `(y-C) sum_i (lambda_i-1) R_i`, where y is the independent fresh input and C is the exact calibration. Hence only the stated weights preserve every output. This conclusion fixes these sends and the rest of the graph; it is not a global supplier optimum.

With the retained 48-call multiplicity, the local signed-margin change is `48*(2*4^(1-kappa)-8^(1-kappa))`, positive for `0<kappa<1`. The full finite caller and increased ordinary work are not repriced here.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-final-helper-audit
```

Both modes print this prefix and elapsed seconds:

```text
PASS_P104_FINAL_HELPER_AUDIT 1279 owners 3 pulse rank
```

Normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. All 19 retained files are authenticated. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44461260655/job/135348321633) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Clear1nsight (@Clear1nsight) supplied the new construction, [final journal](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/913fb6febe28cc3ccad1c16de8e45b8bce0da063/research/p104-subdivided-helper-births/complex/FINAL-BIRTH.json) and [proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/913fb6febe28cc3ccad1c16de8e45b8bce0da063/research/p104-subdivided-helper-births/complex/PROOF.md). The retained overlay constructs the preimage. Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied [PR #7776](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7776)'s [split algebra](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4f7c67ae387cc91580f469aeda4d508b372b9ec1/research/p104-dual-supplier-lift/complex/birth_event.py) and carrier. Its split routine is used for a forward cross-check. [PR #7777](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7777)'s [exact rational expander](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0288431ab2ad0cccfbede0b57cd3edfb2679e0f6/research/p104-first-relay-repair/verify.py) supplies generic coefficient and chart checks. The new inverse, adjoint and error-law checks retain all original notices and source lineage.

The earlier fourteen births, physical word, full caller, binary service, ordinary costs, stock, compiler and selected cold replay did not run. No Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. This is source-aware computational corroboration. All five inherited assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
